name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Continues 0.0.33's WAN-cap staleness fixes and delete-server cleanup with a redesigned config page. Remote user selection is now a dropdown of the remote server's real accounts (name, admin badge) instead of a blind-pasted GUID, fetched on Test/on demand/once per session for already-connected servers, with a manual-entry fallback if a remote can't be reached. Fixed a real bug in the process: per-field autosave silently swallowed errors, so a failed save gave zero feedback - failures now always surface, successes get a brief 'Saved' confirmation. Per-server connection details now default to open instead of hiding Enabled/User/API key behind a collapsed section, with only the genuinely advanced dials (WAN bitrate cap, image API key) moved into a nested, still-collapsed 'Streaming tuning' section. Also fixed a latent gap where adding a new server didn't send its WAN-cap fields at all (harmless today since they'd just take their defaults, but the same missing-field pattern this plugin has been bitten by before).
